mapper.select: select distinct a.TRANSACTIONID,a.EXAMINETYPE,a.TOTALSCORE,a.FIRSTID,b.EXAMINEEMPHASIS,b.SERIALNUMBER,b.EMPLOYMENTOBJECTIVE,max(a.id) as max from tbl_cea_examine_topic_second a left join tbl_cea_examine_topic_first b on a.FIRSTID = b.ID where 1=1 group by a.TRANSACTIONID,a.TRANSACTIONID,a.EXAMINETYPE,a.TOTALSCORE,a.FIRSTID,b.EXAMINEEMPHASIS,b.SERIALNUMBER,b.EMPLOYMENTOBJECTIVE order by max desc
